equations.title: line probe for partner hypersurfaces
equations.equation: rank_locus(L_N(f0+t f1)) = restriction of the codim-1 part of P_N
equations.assumptions: Exact on each line; genericity of the line supported by agreement of independent random lines.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: partner hypersurfaces in degrees 3..19
equations.equation: codim-1 part of P_N nonempty only for N=3 (A^2=B/6) and N=12 (A^2=25B/96)
equations.assumptions: Two independent random lines for N<=14, one line for N<=19. Exact restrictions on tested lines only; genericity and global exclusion are not proved by line probes.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: dense slice
equations.equation: f ~ xy(x-y)(x^3+px^2y+qxy^2+ry^3) for every sextic with three simple roots
equations.assumptions: Simple roots sent to 0,1,infinity; saturate by r and 1+p+q+r.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: covariants over a quotient ring
equations.equation: Clebsch invariants of the slice computed in Q[p,q,r]/I
equations.assumptions: Normal forms modulo a Groebner basis; minimal polynomials of absolute invariants by Krylov iteration.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: quintic partner classification
equations.equation: ker L_5(f)!=0 iff f has a root of multiplicity>=4 or f ~ x^6+(40/7)x^3y^3+y^6
equations.assumptions: Over the algebraic closure; slice ideal of length 20 with B-486A^2, C+26244A^3, D+419904A^5 in I; degenerate forms checked directly.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: octahedral quartic jump
equations.equation: dim ker L_4(f)>=2 iff f ~ xy(x^4-y^4) or f has a root of multiplicity>=5
equations.assumptions: Slice locus zero-dimensional with absolute invariants (0,0,0); degenerate forms checked directly.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: dihedral cubic jump
equations.equation: dim ker L_3(f)>=2 on the slice iff f ~ x^6+y^6
equations.assumptions: Slice locus of length 10 with absolute invariants (6,-36,0); among degenerate forms only fivefold or sixfold roots.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: degree-8 partner classification
equations.equation: ker L_8(f)!=0 iff f has a root of multiplicity>=4 or f ~ x^6+lambda x^3y^3+y^6 (order-3 automorphism) or x^3y^3
equations.assumptions: Converse exact (g8 for all lambda); forward: R5 and C^2-6B^3 vanish on the slice locus modulo two primes; 557 numeric points; supersedes the earlier bielliptic conjecture. Upgraded: verified over Q by msolve (external solver).
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: C3 curve in moduli
equations.assumptions: Lowest-weight relations on the family; a single rational curve in P(1,2,3,5); octahedral at (lambda^2+50)^2=0.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: sextic partner jump
equations.equation: dim ker L_6(f)>=2 iff f has a root of multiplicity>=4
equations.assumptions: Slice ideal of 6x6 minors is the unit ideal away from repeated roots at 0,1 modulo 2147483629 and 1000000007; degenerate forms exact; rational proof open. Upgraded: verified over Q by msolve (external solver).
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: septic partners
equations.equation: ker L_7(f)!=0 iff f has a root of multiplicity>=4
equations.assumptions: Slice ideal of 8x8 minors is the unit ideal off repeated roots modulo two primes; degenerate forms exact; rational proof open. Upgraded: verified over Q by msolve (external solver).
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: partner classification through degree 20
equations.equation: extra partners iff fourfold root, x^3y^3 (even N>=8), x^6+y^6 (N=3,10), octahedral (N=4,14), order-3 family (N=8), C3(40/7) (N=5), or A^2=B/6 (N=3), A^2=25B/96 (N=12)
equations.assumptions: Computer-assisted: slice verdicts over Q by the external solver msolve, cross-checked modulo two primes by Singular; degenerate forms exact; trusting msolve.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: prime-field Groebner evidence
equations.equation: I proper over Q => I mod p proper for all but finitely many primes
equations.assumptions: Fixed integral generators with denominators cleared; finitely many tested primes alone do not certify characteristic-zero emptiness.
equations.source: October 14 2026 session synthesis and recovered archival extracts

equations.title: orbit count check
equations.equation: slice points = 120/|Stab_PGL2(roots)|; 20 for C3(40/7), 10 for x^6+y^6
equations.assumptions: Ordered placements of three simple roots; stabilizer orders 6 and 12.
